mechanism.claim: Within a completed volatile eight-hour BTC block, a premium-index change that predictively rank-aligns with the next minute's BTC return more strongly than BTC returns align with the next premium change identifies derivatives-led information transmission. When completed premium displacement and BTC displacement agree, follow their common direction for the next eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of premium-index displacement and BTC block return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPCR uses only opposite-sign eight-hour premium and BTC displacement; HVPASR uses unsigned daily premium total variation; HVPFPR uses final-hour mean premium pressure; HVFPSC uses actual funding values and a fitted classifier. HVPPLA's primary object is the directional one-minute premium-to-next-price lead advantage over the reverse lag.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed prior-24-hour BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse cross-lag transmission tails at three settlement boundaries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.joined_block: 480 exact timestamp-aligned unique completed BTCUSDT perpetual and premium-index one-minute OHLC rows in [D-8h,D); positive coherent BTC OHLC, finite coherent signed premium OHLC; no imputation
features.premium_lead: Spearman(dp_i,r_(i+1)) for i=1..478 using average-tied ranks; 478 pairs; finite positive result required
features.price_lead: Spearman(r_i,dp_(i+1)) for i=1..478 using average-tied ranks; 478 pairs; finite
features.premium_displacement: last premium close-first premium close; strict nonzero
features.btc_return: log(last BTC close/first BTC open); strict nonzero
features.direction_alignment: strict signs of premium_displacement and btc_return agree
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 prior source-valid boundaries, minimum 180, current excluded
features.eligibility: premium_lead>0, lead_advantage_rank>=0.75, absolute premium-displacement rank>=0.60, BTC realized-variation rank>=0.65, and direction alignment

clock.decision: exact completed eight-hour boundary after every required source minute
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on an equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding cash only after novelty passes
clock.oi_rv20: not signal inputs; RV20 q90 only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no lag, formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
